text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I went out into town with 
Fusaichi Pandora. In front of a rental 
shop—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You had a membership card for this store, 
right? There are sooo many movies I wanna 
watch~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Movies Grandma was in back in the day, or 
old masterpieces she recommended! None of 
them are available on streaming, though~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind renting movies instead. 
However, the last time you rented a bunch 
of manga, you stayed up late and—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Well... it took forever to read 
everything. By the time I went to bed, it 
was morning... *yaaaawn*..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she borrows too many, she might push 
herself too hard trying to watch them all, 
which could interfere with training. I 
should set clear conditions here.
choice_data_list:
If there are too many you won't finish 
watching them all, so three at most, okay?

If there are too many, we won't finish 
looking through them, so limit it to 3.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh~? 3 slices~? Do you really have to~?
choice_data_list:
If I'm borrowing it instead, that's a 
promise, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~... Well, it'd be a waste if we 
didn't finish watching it, so whatever. 
All good, all good~☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Aaaah, there were way too many things I 
wanted to see~! Narrowing it down took 
sooo much brainpower..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Pandora-chan! Yahoo~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yahoo~~! Did you all come to borrow 
something too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's volume 2 of that popular 
suspense drama. Volume 1 was so amazin', I 
don't even know where to start...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The bonus footage on the disc was just as 
rumoredâfull of mysteries begging to be 
unraveled... It felt as though I was being 
tossed about by a fierce gale.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~!? What is that~~!? I wanna know, I 
really wanna know~~!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind a bit of suspense, you 
should check it out from Volume 1, 
Pandora-chan! I'd love it if we could 
share our thoughts on it together.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Found the drama everyone was talking 
about♪ Wait, if I rent this one too, 
that's four discs total..."

text_block_list.name: Pandora in My Heart
text_block_list.text:
"『What's the big deal~? I just wanna see 
everything. Lying to yourself is bad for 
your health, right?』"

text_block_list.name: Pandora in My Heart
text_block_list.text:
"And also, like, as a communication tool? 
I wanna chat about dramas with everyone! 
Trainer, you totally get it, right~♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Right~~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer♪ Lemme borrow this, pretty 
please~~♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waiting near the checkout counter, 
Fusaichi Pandora returned. Checking inside 
the basket she handed over...
choice_data_list: Huh? There are 4 in here, though...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Is this everything?
choice_data_list:
We promised to keep it to three, didn't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, I just wanted to see 
everything so bad~! Even with this, I 
deliberated quite a bit, you know?
choice_data_list:
We can't have it interfering with 
training, right?

It'd be a problem if it got in the way of 
training, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'll be fine!! I'll do my training 
properly, and there's no way I'll stay up 
late watching this, promise!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Right? Right? Pleeaaase♡♡♡ Can't you just 
throw in one more?"
choice_data_list: Still, a promise is a promise...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Ehh~~? Are you reaaally saying... no?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: *tearful sniffle*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"'I shouldn't spoil them too much.' Even 
thinking that, seeing that wistful face 
made me cave...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much♡ I promise I'll 
stick to my screen time limits!
choice_data_list:
(I still have a long way to go myself... 
but still.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If we're watching the drama, maybe at this 
time~? And then, and then, we can chat 
about it the next day~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that she had properly planned out 
her viewing schedule this time, I felt a 
slight sense of relief.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sorrowful expression weighs heavily on 
my heart. However, for the sake of her 
growth, I must steel myself here...!
choice_data_list: I really want you to keep your promise.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, I'll totally stick 
to my screen time limit~...
choice_data_list:
If you bend it that easily, the promise 
won't mean anything, will it?

If you bend it that easily, the promise 
won't mean anything anymore, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh... ...Okay. I'll hold back...
choice_data_list:
If we can keep our promise, let's come 
again next week.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm definitely gonna make up for 
what I missed this time!
